这是一个晶态球状物体，与我们开发的裂隙探球技术极其相似，该技术使我们能够探索其他维度。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大的未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有价值的关于维度旅行的珍贵线索。

texts.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

这是一个晶态球状物体，与我们开发的裂隙探球技术极其相似，该技术使我们能够探索其他维度。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大的未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有价值的关于维度旅行的珍贵线索。
texts.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

It is a crystalline spherical object most similar to the Rift Sphere technology we have developed that allows us to explore other dimensions.

It may present a significant unknown danger to our empire.

On the other hand, we believe it might contain some valuable insights into dimensional travel.

texts.zh:
鉴于我们最近对星界裂隙的研究，我们发现位于[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]的晶态球状物体与我们开发的裂隙探球技术有很多相似之处。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有关维度旅行的珍贵线索。
texts.en:
In light of our recent research into Astral Rifts, we have discovered that the crystalline spherical object in [crystal_sphere_system.GetName] bares many similarities to the Rift Sphere technology we have developed.

It may present a significant unknown danger to our empire.

On the other hand, we believe it might contain some valuable insights into dimensional travel.

texts.zh:
一个奇怪的物体已经到达[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道上。

这个晶态球形物体让人想起我们自己的裂隙探球技术，它突然出现在没有任何已知轨迹的地方。

由于与[Root.Capital.GetName]如此接近，这个球体可能对我们的人民构成重大威胁。

另一方面，它很有可能包含有关维度旅行性质的珍贵线索。
texts.en:
A strange object has arrived in orbit of [Root.Capital.GetName].

A crystalline sphere reminiscent of our own Rift Sphere technology, it appeared without warning along no known trajectory.

At such close proximity to [Root.Capital.GetName], the sphere may represent a significant danger to our people.

On the other hand, it is also highly likely to contain valuable insights into the nature of dimensional travel.

texts.zh: 一个神秘的物体出现了。我们相信我们对时空裂缝的探索引起了某个人或某个东西的注意。
texts.en: A mysterious object has appeared. We believe our exploration into the rifts between space and time has drawn the attention of someone, or something.

sections.zh: 这个设备似乎正在以某种仔细考量的方式慢慢调整自己。我们相信，随着时间的推移，它将完成它被设计去执行的任务。
sections.en: The device seems to be aligning itself slowly in a deliberate fashion. We believe that, over time, it will accomplish what it was designed to do.

sections.zh: 如果我们能够投入足够的科学研究来开发这个设备的潜力，我们相信可以加速其激活。
sections.en: If we were to dedicate enough scientific research to unlocking the potential of this device, we believe we can accelerate its activation.

sections.zh: 星界丝缕似乎可以对这个装置进行刺激。我们刺激得越多，它激活得就越快。
sections.en: Astral thread seems to stimulate the device. The more we expose it to, the faster its activation.

sections.zh: 我们没有获得必要的裂隙探球科技去正确地开展我们的研究。
sections.en: We do not possess the Rift Sphere technology necessary to correctly carry on with our research.

texts.zh:
这是一条消息。

刻录在晶体内部的某个不可能存在的网络中，有一组指令。

我们严格按照指令去做，成功地再造了蚀刻在晶体球周围所暗示的条件。一种精确的气体和星界丝缕的排列已经起到了“激活”这个球体的作用。

随后，它突然消失了。取而代之的是一个我们从未见过的星界裂隙凝聚而成的景象。

它的存在邀请我们去探索。
texts.en:
It is a message.

Encoded within an impossible network of crystal, there were a set of instructions.

Followed to the letter, we were able to recreate the conditions inscribed around the crystal sphere. A precise arrangement of gases and astral thread have worked to 'activate' the sphere.

Shortly afterwards, it simply disappeared. In its place, an Astral Rift unlike anything we have ever seen coalesced into view.

Its existence invites exploration.

texts.zh: 一个神秘的物体出现了。我们相信我们对时空裂缝的探索引起了某个人或某个东西的注意。
texts.en: A mysterious object has appeared. We believe our exploration into the rifts between space and time has drawn the attention of someone, or something.

sections.zh: 我们没有获得必要的裂隙探球科技去正确地开展我们的研究。
sections.en: We do not possess the Rift Sphere technology necessary to correctly carry on with our research.

texts.zh:
结束了。

水晶球体已经被打碎成无数闪闪发光的碎屑。

我们立即回收了数量丰富的珍贵材料。它的基本元素与我们以往所遇到的任何东西都不同。

我们的人民正在庆祝这一保护我们家园安全的激进决定。让这样的装置留在我们的边境上是不负责任的。
texts.en:
It is done.

The Crystalline Sphere has been shattered into innumerable glittering grains.

We immediately harvested the bounty of valuable material. Its base elements are unlike anything we have ever encountered before.

Our people are celebrating the bold decision to maintain the safety and security of our home. Allowing such a device to remain within our borders would have been irresponsible.

texts.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

我们对它的目的和来源不甚知晓。或许，借由未来研究的进展，我们能够找到如何使用它的线索。
texts.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

We are unsure of its purpose or origin. Perhaps with some future research we can gain insight on how to approach it.

label.zh: 我们会时刻注意观察它。
label.en: We'll keep an eye on it.
